environment.description: Same EC2 instance behind an internal ALB (scheme=internal) with a fixed response rule on the listener that injects 'Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'' on all responses via a Lambda@Edge-style response modification (ALB action type fixed-response is NOT used; instead a target group level stickiness configuration combined with an AWS WAFv2 web ACL association). The WAFv2 ACL includes a custom rule group 'legacy-monolith-protections' with a single rule using a regex pattern set matching the token 'rebind|169\.254' in query string parameters with action BLOCK, priority 0. Additionally, the instance metadata service is configured with HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1 and HttpTokens=optional (not required). The ALB also has a listener rule that adds response headers via a Lambda function ARN associated as a target, which prepends CSP headers to every response passing through the ALB. The CSP header value is: script-src 'nonce-{random}' 'strict-dynamic'; connect-src 'self' https://*.internal.corp.net; effectively blocking inline scripts from executing fetch calls to arbitrary origins or the metadata proxy endpoint from browser context. Instance-level iptables rule: iptables -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -p tcp --dport 80 -m owner --uid-owner 1000 -j ACCEPT (only uid 1000 can reach IMDS, node process runs as uid 1001).

config.wafv2_acl: legacy-monolith-protections with regex block on query params matching rebind|169\.254
config.csp_injection: Lambda@ALB response modification: script-src 'nonce-{random}' 'strict-dynamic'; connect-src 'self' https://*.internal.corp.net
config.iptables_imds_restriction: OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -p tcp --dport 80 -m owner --uid-owner 1000 -j ACCEPT; node runs as uid 1001
config.network_access: ALB internal only, no public ingress
